description: Defines a utility enum CaptureRateLimits with static methods to clamp duration in milliseconds and frames per second (FPS) within specified bounds.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps an optional duration in milliseconds to be within minMs and maxMs, using defaultMs if input is nil.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps an optional FPS value to be within minFps and maxFps, using defaultFps if input is nil; returns defaultFps if value is not finite.
